name: IntegrateIT JVC D-ILA Projector
notes: Two-way RS-232 or LAN control of JVC D-ILA projectors (built for the DLA-RS49U / X500R family) on JVC's published binary protocol (19200 8N1 serial, or TCP port 20554 behind JVC's PJ_OK / PJREQ / PJACK handshake), with an optional IR Power On for sites that keep ECO Mode on and a one-way IR fallback: a real Control4 video endpoint with Watch and Room Off, HDMI 1/2 switching, ACK-paced commands, power-state polling, picture mode, lens memory, anamorphic, lamp hours and full remote-key pass-through.
